rules.title: Clean outputs before commit
rules.text: Clear outputs before committing and keep notebooks runnable top to bottom.

rules.title: Move logic to modules
rules.text: Move reusable logic from notebooks into tested Python modules.

rules.title: Relative paths
rules.text: Use paths relative to the project root, never absolute local paths.

rules.title: No secrets in notebooks
rules.text: Never store credentials or tokens in notebook cells or outputs.
